description: Every set with its code, series, print region, release date and, where we hold it, printed total: no Japanese set has one. One call answers questions like "every Japanese set released in 2024". Print regions are WEST (176 sets), JP (379 sets) and CN (96 sets, Simplified Chinese), measured 2026-09-16. Japanese sets are not translations of Western ones: they have their own boundaries, their own numbering and their own release dates, so a Japanese set and its international counterpart are two different rows. If the result carries next_step, show its handoff sentence and URL to the user verbatim and do not retry.
